movie:1107166.overview: Following the brutal murder of her husband, a Kansas highway patrol officer sets out on a journey to track down the perpetrator. As the hunt progresses, she comes to realize the man responsible is a sadistic serial killer, and the depth of his mental depravity and his sinister agenda is more twisted than anyone could have imagined.
movie:1107166.title: Psycho Killer

movie:1165366.overview: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.
movie:1165366.tagline: Some wars are won by armies. Others by those who refuse to surrender.
movie:1165366.title: De Gaulle: Résistance

movie:1428766.overview: Set in 1986, during a scorching Aussie summer, three best friends' celebration at a beach house turns into a blood-soaked fight for survival when a prank goes horribly wrong.
movie:1428766.title: Penny Lane Is Dead

movie:1438966.overview: Je so’ pazzo is an intense portrait of Pino Daniele—a rebellious soul born in the alleys of Naples who revolutionized Italian music by blending blues, jazz, and Neapolitan tradition. The film chronicles his rise, from a childhood marked by abandonment to his legendary 1981 concert before a crowd of 200,000. Amidst family conflicts, personal vulnerabilities, and deep loves, Pino finds a musical language to express what words cannot. Yet success brings new challenges: an unresolved relationship with his father, the burden of expectations, and the risk of repeating past mistakes. It is not merely the story of an extraordinary musician, but that of a man grappling with himself, seeking reconciliation with his roots and the love of a city that never stopped waiting for him.
movie:1438966.title: Je so’ pazzo

movie:417466.overview: On a faraway mountaintop, eight kids with guns watch over a hostage and a conscripted milk cow.
movie:417466.title: Monos

movie:43266.overview: Huw Morgan, the academically inclined youngest son in a proud family of Welsh coal miners, witnesses the tumultuous events of his young life during a period of rapid social change. At the dawn of the 20th-century, a miners' strike divides the Morgans: the sons demand improvements, and the father doesn't want to rock the boat.
movie:43266.tagline: Rich is their humor! Deep are their passions! Reckless are their lives! Mighty is their story!
movie:43266.title: How Green Was My Valley

trailer.name: How Green Was My Valley | #TBT Trailer | 20th Century FOX

cast.c: Joe Thom Pell Aka Pricka Bush Da Werewoof

movie:445466.overview: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.
movie:445466.title: Idiots

movie:606566.overview: Italy from the '80s to the present day, through the dreams, loves, successes and failures of four friends.
movie:606566.title: The Best Years

tv:11466.overview: An offbeat account of King Arthur's quest for the Grail, where virtually every journey, battle or adventure is stopped dead in its tracks by the Knights of the Round Table's most worldly traits: cowardice, greed, idiocy or misplaced chivalry. Consequently, instead of epic adventures, the characters' pragmatism and anachronisms take on each and every event in the Grail legend, true to the purest sitcom tradition.
tv:11466.title: Kaamelott

tv:127366.overview: In the shadowy world of espionage, Sam Fisher is a rumor and a legend. Pulled back into action, he must help a new recruit unravel a global conspiracy.
tv:127366.title: Splinter Cell: Deathwatch

tv:194766.overview: Every summer, Belly and her family head to the Fishers’ beach house in Cousins. Every summer is the same ... until Belly turns sixteen. Relationships will be tested, painful truths will be revealed, and Belly will be forever changed. It’s a summer of first love, first heartbreak and growing up — it's the summer she turns pretty.
tv:194766.title: The Summer I Turned Pretty

trailer.name: The Summer I Turned Pretty Season 3 - Official Trailer | Prime Video

tv:212766.overview: After a brutal war, magic swordsman Kyle defeats the Demon King but is left dying. A crimson crystal sends him four years into the past to his once-destroyed hometown where he finds his lost loved ones alive. Armed with future knowledge, Kyle vows to prevent the coming tragedy and rewrite fate.
tv:212766.title: New Saga

tv:222766.overview: An unrivalled and highly elusive lone assassin, the Jackal, makes his living carrying out hits for the highest fee. But following his latest kill, he meets his match in a tenacious British intelligence officer who starts to track down the Jackal in a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase across Europe, leaving destruction in its wake.
tv:222766.title: The Day of the Jackal

tv:232766.overview: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death — embarking on a relentless path of revenge.
tv:232766.title: Mercy for None

tv:272466.overview: On the run from her troubled past, a young mother is accused of killing her new boss at a flower farm just before discovering he's actually her father.
tv:272466.title: Under a Dark Sun

tv:273866.overview: Mary isn't your typical period drama heroine. She is awkward, anxious, preachy, full of facts, a terrible singer, overlooked by her mother and seemingly destined to an empty dance card for the rest of her life… until Mary takes matters into her own hands.
tv:273866.title: The Other Bennet Sister

tv:285166.overview: Betrayed by his childhood friend and cast out of the Hero Party, Orhun Dura—once their loyal Enchanter—is branded by his former comrades as “a jack-of-all-trades but a master of none.” Alone, he sets out to forge a new path as a solo adventurer. His journey sparks explosive battles, deadly rivals, and unexpected allies—and he’ll rise to shatter every expectation. The ultimate solo comeback begins!
tv:285166.title: Jack-of-All-Trades, Party of None

tv:287366.overview: Netflix reality stars duke it out in hair-raising physical challenges and scheme to avoid elimination to win $250K in this adventurous competition show.
tv:287366.title: Battle Camp

tv:294766.overview: Arrested for reckless space driving, super human Chiharu and cyborg Makina are sentenced to clean the Milky☆Subway—an old interplanetary train. Easy enough, right? Wrong. When the train suddenly takes off, they are thrown into a high-speed space-train spectacle packed with chaos, no plans, and zero strategy. Just pure momentum!
tv:294766.tagline: Misfits of the galaxy, all aboard!
tv:294766.title: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express

tv:295366.overview:
Yoki was once a human but reincarnated into a demon. He now holds a middling position serving the Demon King tasked with taking down the hero party. But when he finally faces them, Yoki thinks... "No way… she's perfect."

Of all things, he fell in love at first sight with Cecilia, the priest of the hero party! Her serious gaze, her every little gesture, everything about her is too cute! She's an angel! And so, Yoki made up his mind that he would confess his feelings to her.
tv:295366.title: There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her

tv:48866.overview: 100 years in the future, when the Earth has been abandoned due to radioactivity, the last surviving humans live on an ark orbiting the planet — but the ark won't last forever. So the repressive regime picks 100 expendable juvenile delinquents to send down to Earth to see if the planet is still habitable.
tv:48866.tagline: Survival isn't who you are. It's who you become.
tv:48866.title: The 100

tv:60866.overview: A medical student who becomes a zombie joins a Coroner's Office in order to gain access to the brains she must reluctantly eat so that she can maintain her humanity. But every brain she eats, she also inherits their memories and must now solve their deaths with help from the Medical examiner and a police detective.
tv:60866.title: iZombie

tv:99966.overview: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out — or turn into one of the rabid infected.
tv:99966.tagline: Hope is the most painful torture for people who want to despair.
tv:99966.title: All of Us Are Dead
